method: Re-checked against the official SQP and marking scheme PDFs with pdftotext -layout, -raw and -table, rendered page images (SQP pp. 4-7, MS pp. 4-6, 11) for figures and equations, and the chapter summaries.

checks.reason: Official answer is a paraphrase, not the scheme's text: MS p5 prints 'Let r be the radius of the inscribed circle', 'ar(△ABC) =ar(△AOC) + ar(△BOC) + ar(△AOB) =½ × r x AC + ½ × r × BC +½ × r × AB', '90 = ½ × 4 (x +8+18+ x +10)', 'x = 4.5cm', '∴ AB=4.5+10=14.5cm' as separate lines, whereas the pack rewrites it ('r=4cm', '(1/2)r(AC+BC+AB)', 'gives x=4.5cm. So AB=...').
